caption: The drawing depicts a woven textile, primarily composed of alternating square patterns in red, blue, and off-white. The squares feature complex, symmetrical floral and leaf motifs, with the red and blue areas containing intricate organic shapes resembling leaves or coral. The off-white background is dotted with small red or blue accents, contributing to the overall pattern. Part of the textile is folded over diagonally at the bottom left, revealing the reverse side but with consistent patterning. On the right and lower parts of the drawing, red, blue, and off-white fringes extend from the edges, depicted with wavy, linear strokes to represent the texture of the fringe. The composition is geometric with a regular grid of squares, creating a checkerboard arrangement of red and blue dominant areas, and includes areas that highlight layering and the fringed border.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
